conf.description: z/OS RACF command audit via zSecure Audit QRadar LEEF interface (dataset=racf-command, format=syslog-leef): parse the standard LEEF pipe-delimited header, branch event.action on the LEEF event id (the command name), keep the extension blob for later attribute mapping - the zSecure interface's specific attribute selection/order for command operands is not published, so attribute-level ECS mapping is a documented gap rather than a guess.

conf.comment: RACF command audit via zSecure LEEF (dataset=racf-command, format=syslog-leef). No Elastic integration/Cribl pack. The work order's own notes say whether ID()/ACCESS()-equivalent operands arrive as discrete LEEF attributes or an embedded rendered string 'depends on the zSecure interface's field selection, which is not published' and the sub-parser 'must fail soft against a captured sample'. This pipeline parses the standard LEEF:version|vendor|product|productVersion|eventId| envelope, which IS standardized, and defers attribute-content mapping rather than guessing key names.

functions.description: Extract the 5 standardized pipe-delimited LEEF header fields plus the extension blob (LEEF 2.0's optional 6th delimiter-declaration field, if present, lands harmlessly at the start of leef_ext since its content is not parsed further)
Map the command-name attribute to event.action, keep vendor/product for provenance, cap and keep the raw extension blob as a fallback field, set event.dataset

conf.comment: GAP, not a guess: the RACF command target (ID()-equivalent) and granted authority (ACCESS()-equivalent) are NOT extracted from the LEEF extension here. The work order explicitly states the zSecure attribute names/order for these operands are unpublished and must be confirmed against a captured sample. Inventing attribute names to regex out of zos_racf.leef.extension_raw would violate the 'do not guess a field name' rule. Once a sample is captured, add attribute-specific extraction here matching the racf-command/other pipeline's ECS targets (user.target.name, racf.command.granted_access, racf.command.specified/.failed/.ignored).
